title: MRISCV — my own SoC
text: A custom RISC-V system-on-chip of my own design, built and iterated as I move from programming microcontrollers to designing the chips themselves.

title: PicoRV32 on Lattice ECP5
text: Running the PicoRV32 RISC-V core on a Lattice ECP5 FPGA — with a 7-segment chip decoder and SPI RAM designed around it.

title: Handmade RF & PCB work
text: PCB layouts in Eagle, plus components I make by hand — wound inductors and crystal ladder filters — because understanding starts at the physical level.

title: Archery score detection
text: Automatic archery scoring using image processing — a camera watches the target and the system detects and scores the arrows.

title: SpO2 & patient monitoring
text: Patient monitoring hardware built around SpO2 sensing — measuring blood oxygen and keeping watch over the numbers that matter.

title: Vaccine temperature box
text: Temperature monitoring for vaccine storage boxes, so the cold chain stays provably cold from storage to delivery.

title: Hydroponics hardware control
text: Control hardware for hydroponic growing — automating the environment plants live in, from my time at Tanam Kota and freelance builds.

title: Plasma sterilizer monitoring
text: Temperature monitoring for a plasma sterilizer — precision sensing where the process only works inside a tight thermal window.

title: Racing plane avionics
text: Electrical design and piloting for the Dirgantara PENS racing plane team — avionics that had to be light, reliable, and fast. Finisher, KRTI 2020.
